title: Minuta 2025-08-07
summary: The minutes of the 7 August decision (25bp cut to 7.75%, split 4-1 with Heath again dissenting for a hold) execute the more gradual pace the June minutes had flagged: the majority judged it appropriate to continue the easing cycle, citing peso appreciation, weak activity with a widening negative output gap, a cooling labor market and possible trade-policy impacts, and signaled it will weigh additional cuts while stressing that a gradual approach gives continuity to the cycle. Versus the previous minutes, headline inflation has improved markedly (back within the variability interval at 3.51% on a sharp drop in the non-core component), which softens the tone relative to June's alarm, but the core-persistence debate remains intense: members note core is stuck, merchandise inflation rose to 4.02%, the core forecast was revised up for a third consecutive time, and analysts' medium/long-term expectations stay unanchored around 3.6-3.7%. The minutes read modestly MORE HAWKISH than the communique: they surface a forceful Heath dissent arguing there is no room to cut and the restrictive stance must be kept, plus a cautious member warning the absolute stance is near neutrality and the Fed differential is close to post-2008 lows, so further adjustments must be more gradual. The dovish pillars (deepening slack, moderating wages, a strong peso and a weak dollar keeping global financial conditions loose) still dominate the decision, leaving the board tilted toward further but smaller, data-dependent cuts.

key_quotes.quote: la Junta de Gobierno con la presencia de todos sus miembros, decidió por mayoría reducir en 25 puntos base el objetivo para la Tasa de Interés Interbancaria a un día a un nivel de 7.75%.
key_quotes.context: Collegial decision: 25bp cut to 7.75% by majority, one dissent

key_quotes.quote: hacia delante se valorarán recortes adicionales, y que un enfoque gradual contribuirá a dar continuidad al ciclo de recortes.
key_quotes.context: Forward guidance: more cuts on the table, but a gradual pace

key_quotes.quote: la inflación subyacente no da señales de reducción.
key_quotes.context: Dissenting/hawkish member on stuck core inflation; core forecast revised up again

key_quotes.quote: la posición absoluta está cerca del intervalo de neutralidad, por lo que los ajustes deben ser más graduales
key_quotes.context: Member judging the absolute stance is close to neutral, limiting room and demanding gradualism
